title: 584. Contiguous Array

examples.explanation: The whole array has one 0 and one 1.
Both [0,1] and [1,0] are balanced with length 2.
The slice [1,0,0,0,1,1] has three 0s and three 1s.

hints: Replace each 0 with -1 so a balanced slice becomes a subarray summing to zero.
Record the first index where each running total appears; a repeat marks a zero-sum slice.
Seed the map with total 0 at index -1 so slices starting at the front are measured.
